renderedFields.description:
As an Organization user, I want to view and access only the eCore modules authorized for my organization, so that I can navigate to New Transaction, Workspace, and Preferences from the Dashboard main screen; access Home, New Transaction, Workspace, and Preferences from the top-right navigation menu; access Organization and Vault as sub-items under Preferences; and return to the Home page using Command Center.

The UI and supporting APIs must provide consistent module access and prevent unauthenticated or unauthorized access.

comments.body:
• Created Jira ticket ETA-411 and executed the end-to-end flow through the POC automation framework.
  • During execution, the framework required additional clarification due to limited details and description of the Home Page icons in the Jira ticket, resulting in multiple queries and increased processing time for requirement and Acceptance Criteria generation.
  • Identified several test failures during actual execution. The Healer Agent successfully analyzed and corrected the scripts for some of the failures, while a few issues are still pending and currently being worked on for resolution.

• Completed the development and stabilization of the AI-assisted POC automation framework, and the end-to-end workflow is now functioning as expected.
  • The framework successfully processes Jira tickets, generates requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Test Plans, and BDD automation scripts, including feature files, step definitions, and page objects.
  • Integrated Healer Agents to handle locator- and code-related issues during execution, enabling automated script correction where required.
  • Successfully validated the generated test cases through execution, with test results and coverage reports generated successfully.
  • The framework is now ready for further enhancements and refinement based on upcoming requirements and feedback.
